kv: A kV is a unit of potential equal to a thousand volts.
KV means the same as kilovolt.
kvass: Kvass is fermented beverage resembling beer but made from rye or barley.
kvetch: Kvetch can also mean express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness.
Kvetch can also mean a nagging complaint.
Kvetch means the same as complain or kick or plain.
